name: Sekret sadyby Chakluna
source:
Old Archmage Tulewaisuus left many secrets. One of which is his manor in Burachkovo Forest. It is said that there exists the secret somnabulistic library, containing the most legendary spells capable of manipulating space and time, as well as making wishes come true. But is it real? And if so, what price must a wizard pay to gain access to it?

[Translated from [url=https://kenkasuga.itch.io/thesorcerersmanor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
老大法师图勒瓦苏斯留下了许多秘密。其中之一是他在布拉奇科沃森林的庄园。据说，这里有一个秘密的梦游图书馆，里面藏有最传奇的咒语，能够操纵时空，实现愿望。但这是真的吗？如果是这样，巫师必须付出什么代价才能获得它？

[译自[url=https://kenkasuga.itch.io/thesorcerersmanor]itch.io[/url]]
